counterargs.read: Today's data is quiet on its face — small moves across most series — but the underlying mix (oil reversing, credit softening slightly, yields drifting up, even as vol compresses) doesn't confirm any clean regime. The likeliest read is a market holding its breath: vol compression into a binary Fed event usually reflects complacency or genuine confidence, not resolved uncertainty. Warsh's actual remarks (expected over the next 1-3 days) plus tonight's delayed H.4.1 print are what will move this from 'mixed, low-conviction' to an actual signal.
